summary: Tested new forgot-password / reset-password feature end-to-end (backend + UI) plus regression on login and register. All 8 new backend tests pass and all UI mode transitions (login → forgot → reset → back-to-login) work correctly. Admin email send returns 202 Accepted via managed Resend proxy.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py forgot_password swallows any HTTPException from send_email silently — good for no-enumeration, but broader exception handling (network errors, timeouts) is not caught; a raw exception could leak enumeration via 500. Consider `except Exception:` around send_email.
test_credentials: Admin mattsossi@bsossi.com / CoParents2026! (verified). Test users generated inline with uuid, .example emails (deliverable-blocked in Resend which is expected).
seed_data_creation: Test-only users with `pwreset_*@example.com` and `uitest_*@example.com` created via /api/auth/register. Not cleaned up (idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Password reset tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_password_reset.py. Run with: `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_password_reset.py -v -o addopts=''` (project pytest.ini enables xdist which breaks on single-file runs unless addopts is cleared). Known code hash for '654321' is set via mongo password_resets upsert. Admin email actually delivers (202); .example/.com test emails are blocked as 'undeliverable_recipient' by Resend — this is expected and not an app bug (send_email failure is swallowed in forgot_password by design).
